WARN.summary: Implicit access-token or ID-token issuance is enabled on the app registration.
actions: Ask the application team whether implicit or hybrid token issuance is still required. Do not disable it without checking compatibility.
Where supported, migrate to authorization code flow with PKCE using a supported authentication library.
After the application has been updated, open App registrations > this application > Authentication, turn off the unused implicit-grant options and save. Run the report again.

UNKNOWN.summary: The report could not read both implicit token issuance settings.
actions: Ask the report administrator to check app registration collection and Application.Read.All consent.
Collect a new report before deciding whether the application needs an authentication change.
